passages.title: 茶文化
passages.intro: 六级翻译常考中国文化类，注意"源于""传播到""被视为"三类句型的处理。

sentences.cn: 茶起源于中国，距今已有四千多年的历史。
sentences.ref: Tea originated in China and has a history of more than four thousand years.
sentences.tip: 两个分句可以用 and 连接，不必强行写成从句。

sentences.cn: 唐代以后，饮茶逐渐成为一种普遍的生活习惯。
sentences.ref: After the Tang Dynasty, tea drinking gradually became a common habit of daily life.
sentences.tip: "饮茶"作主语用动名词 tea drinking，比 people drink tea 简洁。

sentences.cn: 中国茶按照加工方式分为绿茶、红茶、乌龙茶等几大类。
sentences.ref: Chinese tea is classified into several major types, such as green tea, black tea and oolong tea, according to the way it is processed.
sentences.tip: 注意"红茶"是 black tea，不是 red tea，这是常考陷阱。

sentences.cn: 如今，茶不仅是一种饮品，更承载着中国人待客的礼仪。
sentences.ref: Today, tea is not only a beverage but also a carrier of the Chinese etiquette of receiving guests.
sentences.tip: "承载"不要直译成 load，carry / embody 更自然。

sentences.cn: 随着中外交流的加深，越来越多的外国人开始了解并喜爱中国茶。
sentences.ref: With the deepening of exchanges between China and other countries, more and more foreigners have come to understand and enjoy Chinese tea.

keys.en: exchanges between China and other countries

sentences.tip: come to do 表示"逐渐开始"，比 begin to 更贴合语境。

passages.title: 高速铁路
passages.intro: 经济与科技类常考"发展迅速""缩短距离""促进交流"，注意数据表达。

sentences.cn: 中国高速铁路运营里程已超过四万公里，居世界首位。
sentences.ref: The operating length of China’s high-speed railways has exceeded 40,000 kilometres, ranking first in the world.

keys.en: operating length / total length in operation

sentences.tip: 数字后面别漏单位 kilometres；ranking 作伴随状语是加分句式。

sentences.cn: 高铁把许多城市之间的旅行时间缩短了一半以上。
sentences.ref: High-speed rail has cut travel time between many cities by more than half.
sentences.tip: cut … by half 是固定搭配，by 后面是"减少的幅度"。

sentences.cn: 它不仅方便了人们的出行，也带动了沿线地区的经济发展。
sentences.ref: It has not only made travel more convenient but also boosted economic development in the areas along the lines.
sentences.tip: not only…but also… 连接两个并列谓语，注意时态一致。

sentences.cn: 在一些偏远地区，高铁为当地居民提供了更多就业机会。
sentences.ref: In some remote areas, high-speed rail has provided local residents with more job opportunities.
sentences.tip: provide sb with sth 与 provide sth for sb 都可，但不要混用。

sentences.cn: 可以预见，高铁将在区域协调发展中发挥更大作用。
sentences.ref: It can be predicted that high-speed rail will play a greater role in coordinated regional development.
sentences.tip: It can be predicted that 是万能开头，比 We can see 正式。

passages.title: 移动支付
passages.intro: 科技类常考"普及""改变生活方式""安全与隐私"，注意被动与比较。

sentences.cn: 移动支付在中国的普及速度远远超出人们的预期。
sentences.ref: The spread of mobile payment in China has far exceeded people’s expectations.
sentences.tip: "普及速度"可译 spread 或 popularity，用 speed of 反而生硬。

sentences.cn: 如今，人们只需用手机扫一扫，就可以完成购物、缴费等各种支付。
sentences.ref: Today, people can complete various payments, such as shopping and bill payment, simply by scanning a code with their phones.
sentences.tip: simply by doing 比 only need to 更简洁。

sentences.cn: 这一变化给商家和消费者都带来了便利，也减少了现金的使用。
sentences.ref: This change has brought convenience to both businesses and consumers, and has reduced the use of cash.
sentences.tip: both A and B 的位置：both businesses and consumers。

sentences.cn: 但与此同时，个人信息安全和隐私保护也成为人们关注的问题。
sentences.ref: At the same time, however, the security of personal information and the protection of privacy have become issues of public concern.
sentences.tip: 把"人们关注的问题"处理成 issues of public concern，避免逐字翻译。

sentences.cn: 因此，在推广新技术的同时，也需要相应的法律来规范其使用。
sentences.ref: Therefore, while promoting new technology, we also need corresponding laws to regulate its use.
sentences.tip: while 引导的状语从句省略主语时用 doing，注意与主句主语一致。

passages.title: 春节
passages.intro: 节日类常考"农历""团圆""习俗""传承"，注意专有名词与文化词。

sentences.cn: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日，通常在农历正月初一。
sentences.ref: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China, usually falling on the first day of the first lunar month.

keys.en: the first day of the first lunar month

sentences.tip: falling on 作伴随状语，比 which is on 更高级。

sentences.cn: 节前，人们会打扫房屋、贴春联、准备年货。
sentences.ref: Before the festival, people clean their houses, put up spring couplets and prepare festival goods.
sentences.tip: 三个动作用并列，注意 put up 不要写成 post。

sentences.cn: 除夕之夜，全家人围坐在一起吃年夜饭，这被视为一年中最重要的一顿饭。
sentences.ref: On New Year’s Eve, the whole family sits together for the reunion dinner, which is regarded as the most important meal of the year.
sentences.tip: which 引导非限制性定语从句，是最稳的扩展手段。

sentences.cn: 近年来，虽然庆祝方式有所变化，但团圆的主题始终没有改变。
sentences.ref: In recent years, although the ways of celebration have changed somewhat, the theme of reunion has remained unchanged.
sentences.tip: although 与 but 不能同现，中文的"虽然……但……"只保留一个。

sentences.cn: 如今，春节不仅是家庭团聚的时刻，也成为向世界展示中国文化的重要窗口。
sentences.ref: Today, the Spring Festival is not only a time for family reunion but also an important window through which Chinese culture is shown to the world.

keys.en: a window through which … is shown

sentences.tip: window through which 结构体现语法能力，但务必保证从句完整。

passages.title: 教育与乡村振兴
passages.intro: 社会类常考"投入""改善条件""留住人才"，注意比较级与被动。

sentences.cn: 近年来，中国加大了对农村教育的投入。
sentences.ref: In recent years, China has increased its investment in rural education.
sentences.tip: increase 比 make more 准确；investment in 后面接名词。

sentences.cn: 许多农村学校的教学条件得到了明显改善。
sentences.ref: The teaching conditions of many rural schools have been significantly improved.
sentences.tip: "得到改善"用被动最自然，significantly 提升档次。

sentences.cn: 然而，与城市相比，农村地区仍然难以吸引和留住优秀教师。
sentences.ref: However, compared with cities, rural areas still find it difficult to attract and retain qualified teachers.
sentences.tip: find it difficult to 中的 it 是形式宾语，不能省。

sentences.cn: 为了解决这一问题，一些地方提高了农村教师的待遇，并提供了更多培训机会。
sentences.ref: To solve this problem, some places have raised the pay of rural teachers and offered more training opportunities.
sentences.tip: To solve this problem 作目的状语，位置放句首。

sentences.cn: 教育公平是社会公平的基础，缩小城乡差距仍有很长的路要走。
sentences.ref: Educational equity is the foundation of social equity, and there is still a long way to go in narrowing the gap between urban and rural areas.

keys.en: there is still a long way to go

sentences.tip: there is still a long way to go 是固定表达，比 need much time 地道。

passages.title: 新能源与环境保护
passages.intro: 环保类常考"减少排放""发展新能源""共同责任"，注意因果与并列。

sentences.cn: 随着环境问题日益突出，发展新能源已成为全球共识。
sentences.ref: As environmental problems become increasingly serious, developing new energy has become a global consensus.
sentences.tip: As 引导时间/原因状语从句，主句用现在完成时呼应"已"。

sentences.cn: 中国在太阳能和风能领域的装机容量位居世界前列。
sentences.ref: China ranks among the world’s leaders in installed capacity in the fields of solar and wind power.
sentences.tip: rank among 比 is one of the best 更书面。

sentences.cn: 这些努力不仅减少了碳排放，也创造了大量就业岗位。
sentences.ref: These efforts have not only reduced carbon emissions but also created a large number of jobs.
sentences.tip: 现在完成时强调"至今的成果"，比一般过去时更贴合。

sentences.cn: 然而，新能源的发展仍面临成本高、储存难等挑战。
sentences.ref: However, the development of new energy still faces challenges such as high cost and difficult storage.
sentences.tip: such as 后接名词短语，保持并列结构一致。

sentences.cn: 保护环境是每个人的责任，只有共同努力，才能实现可持续发展。
sentences.ref: Protecting the environment is everyone’s responsibility; only through joint efforts can we achieve sustainable development.
sentences.tip: Only + 状语置于句首时主句必须部分倒装，这是高频语法得分点。

phrases.en: give full play to one’s advantages
pass down from generation to generation
